newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Prairies to see sun west, cloud east.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Prairies to see sun west, cloud east.

text.p: Canada's Prairies on Monday were forecast to see sun in the west and cloud in the east, Environment Canada said.
Alberta should see mainly sunny skies with highs of 22 to 26 Celsius. Late thundershowers were expected in the northwest.
Saskatchewan should see a mix of sun and cloud with highs of 18 to 23 Celsius.
Manitoba should see a mix of sun and cloud with highs of 18 to 22 Celsius.
